hero.title:
A Joyful Beginning
for a *Brighter Tomorrow*
hero.imageAlt: Kindergarten children learning together in a Lawrence High School classroom

programme.title: Learning Through Joy and Discovery
programme.body: We believe that the early years are a time of endless possibilities. Our play-based and activity-driven approach helps children build essential skills in literacy, numeracy, communication and creativity, while nurturing curiosity and confidence.

photos.alt: A kindergarten child and parent decorating a pot together at Lawrence High School
Families learning classroom rules together in a kindergarten classroom
A teacher making music with kindergarten children at Lawrence High School

curriculum.title: Age-appropriate Learning, A Strong Foundation for Life.

stages.title: Nursery
stages.body: A joyful introduction through rhymes, stories, art, pre-math concepts, phonics and play.

stages.title: LKG
stages.body: Building early reading, numeracy and communication through engaging activities, three-letter words, theme-based learning and exploration.

stages.title: UKG
stages.body: A well-rounded programme that strengthens academics, creativity, communication skills and independent thinking.

development.title: Nurturing Every Aspect of a Child’s Growth

items.title: Physical Development
items.text: Indoor and outdoor activities and motor skills

visible.title: Every Experience Tells a Story
visible.body: Our Making Learning Visible approach invites parents into the classroom to witness the learning journey as it happens. Through displays, portfolios and child-led presentations, we celebrate progress, creativity and confidence.

families.title: A Stronger Journey Together
families.body: We value the involvement of parents and grandparents in every kindergarten journey. Through regular interactions, workshops and celebrations, we create a meaningful home-school partnership that nurtures every child’s growth.
